errorCodes.meaning: No such did:webs DID is held by this VTA, or the caller cannot reach its context.

DesignatedService.description: A DID document service entry the AID designates for itself: an ACDC it issues in its own registry, anchored in its key event log, which the host renders into `service`. Not a KERI endpoint reply, which can carry only KERI's own roles and URL schemes. `id` is a fragment relative to the DID. Members other than `id`, `type` and `serviceEndpoint` are carried as the DID document data model allows.

id.description: The service's fragment, such as `#files`. `#didcomm` and `#tsp` are the VTA's own (see `addMediatorService` and `addTspService`), and an id a KERI endpoint reply of the AID already establishes cannot be reused.

serviceEndpoint.description: A URI, a map, or a set of either, as the DID document data model allows.

type.description: The service type, matched by peers on its value, never on `id`.

DesignatedService.title: DesignatedService

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

keriCesr.description: The keri.cesr stream as the VTA last published it, present only when `includeKeriCesr` was true. Its absence means it was not asked for, never that the DID has no history.

rotationStaged.description: Present and true when a rotation is staged but not yet committed: the host may already serve it. The VTA completes it before writing anything else.

Response.title: VTA did:webs DIDs Get — response payload

WebsDidRecord.description: A did:webs DID as the VTA holds it. The DID document is not here: the host derives it from `keri.cesr`, which `vta/webs/dids/get` returns on request. Every key named here is public, and every key id names a key the VTA holds and never returns.

aid.description: The KERI autonomic identifier: the self-addressing digest of the inception event, and the DID's final segment. It never changes: a rotation changes the keys, not the AID.

alsoKnownAs.description: The designated aliases in force, the DID itself first. The did:webs resolution of the DID requires the AID to designate it, so the list is never empty while the DID is live.

contextId.description: Context the DID belongs to. Its keys were derived in it, and deleting that context destroys them.

deactivated.description: True once `vta/webs/dids/delete` has published the rotation to no next keys. Irreversible.

deactivatedAt.description: When the deactivating rotation was published. Present exactly when `deactivated` is true.

did.description: The DID: `did:webs:<domain>:<path segments>:<AID>`, a port in the domain written `%3A<port>`.

didJsonUrl.description: Where the derived document is served: `https://<domain>/<slot>/did.json`.

domain.description: The hosting domain, decoded (`localhost:8534`, not `localhost%3A8534`). Load-bearing: the host builds the DID from its domain and slot on every read.

keriCesrUrl.description: Where the key event log is served: `https://<domain>/<slot>/keri.cesr`.

keyAgreementKey.description: The designated key agreement key in CESR (an X25519 key, `C…`). Never the X25519 key converted from a signing key.

keyAgreementKeyId.description: The VTA's id for the designated key agreement key.

nextKeyId.description: The VTA's id for the committed successor, whose digest is the key state's one next-key commitment (`nt` 1). Inactive until the rotation that installs it. Absent once the DID is deactivated, when nothing is committed.

primary.description: Whether this is its context's primary DID.

sequenceNumber.description: Sequence number of the latest event in the key event log.

serverId.description: The VTA's id for the hosting server that serves the slot.

services.description: The designated services in force, `#didcomm` and `#tsp` included when present.

signingKey.description: The current signing key in CESR (an Ed25519 key, `D…`). The document's verification method for it is `<did>#<signingKey>`.

signingKeyId.description: The VTA's id for the current signing key, the one key of the key state (`kt` 1). It signs the DID's key events and what the DID signs as itself. After deactivation, the key the final rotation installed, which the VTA signs nothing more with.

slot.description: The slot on the hosting server: the path segments, then the AID, separated by `/`.

versionId.description: The latest event as `<sequence number>:<SAID>`, the form `expectedVersionId` is compared against (vta/dids method profile `webs`, §3). Both parts are compared: a sequence number alone does not distinguish two events at the same position.

schema.description: Fetch one did:webs DID the VTA holds, optionally with its keri.cesr stream. Alpha.

includeKeriCesr.description: Return the DID's keri.cesr stream as well as the record. Absent means no. The stream is the DID's whole key event history and its designations, and is the only thing the derived document can be checked against.
